title: The sprint skill's resume step and the backlog usage text name the worker spend cap
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md names --max-budget-usd (or KB_WORKER_BUDGET_USD) for dispatch and for the claude -p --resume of a stopped worker, and backlog.py dispatch --help shows the flag

run:
import sys,subprocess
s=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();h=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','dispatch','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
ok=('max-budget-usd' in s or 'KB_WORKER_BUDGET_USD' in s) and 'max-budget-usd' in h
print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
